title: Market-open DCA run classification block (9:35 AM ET live execution)
description: The run_classification object embedded in every MARKET-OPEN run_state artifact. The market-open stream is a single 9:35 AM ET live Robinhood execution (run_type='market_open_dca_live', trades=true) on the account supplied by $ROBINHOOD_AGENTIC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER (never committed). It uses the same $2-base 0x-to-5x sizing ladder as the morning/midday/afternoon live streams. It is INDEPENDENT of the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes ce16ba6b): stream='market_open' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false always, so afternoon slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never treats a market-open artifact as afternoon scheduled evidence. Market-open scheduled fills count only as prior-allocation context for the morning, midday, and afternoon same-day top-up guards (Codex review: "Feed market-open fills into later top-up guards"). Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Origin of the market-open run. 'scheduled' is the 9:35 AM ET live execution; everything else is 'manual'.

run_type.description: 'market_open_dca_live' for the 9:35 AM ET live execution. Deliberately never the afternoon 'scheduled_live_test' or any morning/midday/intraday run_type.

stream.description: Stream marker. Always 'market_open' so this artifact is never confused with the morning, midday, intraday, or afternoon stream.

trades.description: Always true: the market-open stream is a live Robinhood execution.

manual_run.description: true for manual market-open runs, false for scheduled market-open runs. Must agree with run_origin.

cron_id.description: Market-open task id: '2ba19526' for the 9:35 AM ET live execution. Distinct from the morning ('42173154'), midday ('a6239dae'), intraday ('7be82b97'), and afternoon ('10ce362c') live tasks.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Always null: the market-open task supersedes nothing.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time, HH:MM. '09:35' for scheduled runs; null for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted market-open window in ET, HH:MM.

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted market-open window in ET, HH:MM.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Contract version tag: 'market-open-live-v1' for the live execution.

valid_afternoon_evidence.description: Always false. A market-open artifact is NEVER valid afternoon scheduled-live evidence; it counts only as prior-allocation context for the morning/midday/afternoon same-day top-up guards.

afternoon_live_cron_id.description: The afternoon live task id ('10ce362c') recorded for cross-reference only.

allOf.comment: Scheduled live execution: pinned window and run_id pattern.
Manual runs never use a scheduled run_id and are always manual_run=true.
